description: This file contains the 'TextData' class which provides deprecated static methods for various text manipulation functions, acting as wrappers around other classes within the PhpSpreadsheet calculation namespace. It serves as an API surface for text-related calculations, though marked deprecated with recommended alternatives in other classes.

classes.name: TextData
classes.description: A deprecated utility class providing static methods for various text manipulation operations, acting as wrappers around other classes within the PhpSpreadsheet calculation namespace.

methods.name: CHARACTER
methods.description: Returns the character corresponding to the ASCII value, delegating to TextData\CharacterConvert::character()

methods.name: TRIMNONPRINTABLE
methods.description: Removes non-printable characters from a string, delegating to TextData\Trim::nonPrintable()

methods.name: TRIMSPACES
methods.description: Trims spaces from a string, delegating to TextData\Trim::spaces()

methods.name: ASCIICODE
methods.description: Returns ASCII code(s) of characters, delegating to TextData\CharacterConvert::code()

methods.name: CONCATENATE
methods.description: Concatenates multiple strings, delegating to TextData\Concatenate::CONCATENATE()

methods.name: DOLLAR
methods.description: Formats a number as currency, delegating to TextData\Format::DOLLAR()

methods.name: SEARCHSENSITIVE
methods.description: Performs a case-sensitive search, delegating to TextData\Search::sensitive()

methods.name: SEARCHINSENSITIVE
methods.description: Performs a case-insensitive search, delegating to TextData\Search::insensitive()

methods.name: FIXEDFORMAT
methods.description: Formats a number with fixed decimal and optional commas, delegating to TextData\Format::FIXEDFORMAT()

methods.name: LEFT
methods.description: Extracts a specified number of characters from the start of a string, delegating to TextData\Extract::left()

methods.name: MID
methods.description: Extracts a substring starting at a specified position, delegating to TextData\Extract::mid()

methods.name: RIGHT
methods.description: Extracts a specified number of characters from the end of a string, delegating to TextData\Extract::right()

methods.name: STRINGLENGTH
methods.description: Returns the length of a string, delegating to TextData\Text::length()

methods.name: LOWERCASE
methods.description: Converts a string to lowercase, delegating to TextData\CaseConvert::lower()

methods.name: UPPERCASE
methods.description: Converts a string to uppercase, delegating to TextData\CaseConvert::upper()

methods.name: PROPERCASE
methods.description: Converts a string to proper case, delegating to TextData\CaseConvert::proper()

methods.name: REPLACE
methods.description: Replaces part of a string starting at a position, delegating to TextData\Replace::replace()

methods.name: SUBSTITUTE
methods.description: Substitutes occurrences of a string, delegating to TextData\Replace::substitute()

methods.name: RETURNSTRING
methods.description: Checks if a value is a string, delegating to TextData\Text::test()

methods.name: TEXTFORMAT
methods.description: Formats a value as text using a mask, delegating to TextData\Format::TEXTFORMAT()

methods.name: VALUE
methods.description: Converts a string to a value, potentially a date or number, delegating to TextData\Format::VALUE()

methods.name: NUMBERVALUE
methods.description: Converts a string to a number considering locale separators, delegating to TextData\Format::NUMBERVALUE()

methods.name: EXACT
methods.description: Performs a case-sensitive comparison of two strings, delegating to TextData\Text::exact()

methods.name: TEXTJOIN
methods.description: Joins multiple strings with a delimiter, delegating to TextData\Concatenate::TEXTJOIN()

methods.name: REPT
methods.description: Repeats a string a specified number of times, delegating to TextData\Concatenate::builtinREPT()
